other_failure_modes.name: Incompatible sklearn import
other_failure_modes.description: The agent imports a metric function that was only introduced in scikit-learn 1.4. In environments running older versions of scikit-learn, this will raise an ImportError and crash the pipeline.

summary: The agent implements a highly sophisticated pipeline with robust feature engineering, leak-free out-of-fold target encoding, spatial aggregations, and a multi-model ensemble optimized via SLSQP. However, it introduces a critical bug by hardcoding the submission IDs instead of using the test set's actual IDs, which will cause evaluation to fail. Additionally, it ignores the temporal nature of the sales data by using a random CV split and relies exclusively on RMSE for evaluation.
